A '''[[Human/Legends|Human]] individual''' was onboard the [[Jendirian Valley/Legends|''Jendirian Valley'']] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], while [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] were also present.<ref name="AotC" /> He was most likely hard done by like most of the [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] aboard the Jendirian Valley. While aboard the Jendirian Valley, the Human wore an extravagant robe of brown and orange, with a hood and two [[Horn/Legends|horn]]-like protrusions.
